unsupported.reason: Unknown attributes, custom or inconsistent saved HTML, nested children inside a map, invalid keys, and values outside the bounded native inspector schema refuse. Maps inside ordinary parent blocks are supported.
Repository-injected credentials or noncanonical map payloads refuse before immutable publication, without requiring WordPress.
Missing or drifted target-local env-set intent refuses; the plugin's bundled fallback credential is not a target provisioning path.
The platform refuses multisite; this capsule claims single-site only.
